svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 3 — Panel 2: MED Theodore at automaton shop window
svg.desc: MED 50mm eye level. Theodore paused at a shop window, watching a small mechanical automaton behind the glass — a tiny brass figure that turns and raises a hammer to strike a bell. Theodore's reflection visible in the glass, mirrored with the machine. Right hand rises unconsciously, fingers tracing the automaton's motion in the air. Left thumb turns brass gear ring on his index finger. Expression: unguarded fascination, delight — the face he shows when no one is watching. Grey daylight behind him, warm amber from shop interior casting golden light across his face.
